checks: Closed proposal digest and exact immutable policy; no caller-selected command, key, URL or path.
Only the designated requester can reach signing; exporter peer is the signer and per-packet kernel credentials bind the actual sender.
Three distinct sealed memfds carry exact artifact names/sizes/hashes; aliases, truncation, unsealed data and protocol suffixes are rejected.
Ancillary parsing collects every received descriptor before refusal and closes descriptors on failed validation.
Signer validates the passed report, exact steps, sources, producer recipe and artifact correspondence before signing.
Ed25519 key identity is derived and checked against immutable public policy; domain-separated canonical payload and signature are verified by the client.
Only signer has LoadCredential; exporter has readonly cache and no credentials, signer cannot access collector cache, candidate worker has no signing credential.
No unit or socket is automatically activated; module evaluation preserves all service properties except the intentional worker/collector executable bindings.
Original worker core remains byte-exact and candidate isolation remains its established contract.
Current coordinator is unchanged; a separate adapter and real systemd/UID traversal are explicitly absent from this proof.
limits: A valid v2 cache may be reused. issued_at is the signature time, not evidence of a new validator execution or execution recency for each job.

Twenty native tests exercise same-user local fixtures with authentic kernel transport and cryptography; distinct production UIDs, systemd sockets and LoadCredential are not established by this review.
No actual 74-step verifier run, Forgejo status transition, human approval, merge or delivery is claimed.
No production identity, key, capacity or authority policy has been selected; CI rollout remains separate from release005.
scope: independent static protocol/module and artifact/evidence binding review only
